```{r}
#Trial demographics

data<- read_excel("AK_Clean_Temp_3.xlsx", col_types = c("text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", "text",
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "numeric", "text", "text",
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text"))



# Specify the columns to include
selected_columns <- c(
  "Solid", "Heme", "Solid_clinically_localized_tx", "Solid_neoadjuvant", "Solid_topical",
  "Solid_radition_systemic_tx", "Solid_adjuvant_after_defintive_tx", 
  "Solid_Metastatic_tx_naieve", "Solid_Metastatic_2ndline_beyond", 
  "Heme_Treatment_naieve", "Heme_Relapsed_and_or_referactory", 
  "Heme_BMT", "Study_Type", "Randomized", "Follow_Up_Period_Years", 
  "Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Control_Arm", 
  "Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Interventional_Arm", 
  "Control_Group_1_placebo_2SOCalone_3_none", 
  "Blinding_Practice_1_pt_blind_0_open", "Sponser", 
  "Location_Of_Trial", "Single_Site_Or_Multi_Site", 
  "Number_Enrolled_In_Trial", "discontinuation_rate_total"
)

# Filter the data to include only the selected columns using base R
data <- data[, selected_columns]

# Verify the structure of the filtered data
str(data)
# Continuous variable summary
continuous_summary <- data %>%
  mutate(Follow_Up_Period_Months = Follow_Up_Period_Years * 12) %>%
  summarize(
    Follow_Up_Period_Months = paste0(
      median(Follow_Up_Period_Months, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      IQR(Follow_Up_Period_Months, na.rm = TRUE), ")"
    ),
    Number_Enrolled_In_Trial = paste0(
      sum(Number_Enrolled_In_Trial, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      median(Number_Enrolled_In_Trial, na.rm = TRUE), ")"
    ),
    Discontinuation_Rate_Total = paste0(
      median(discontinuation_rate_total, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
      IQR(discontinuation_rate_total, na.rm = TRUE), ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Characteristic", values_to = "Value")

# Summarize categorical variables
categorical_columns <- c(
  "Solid", "Heme", "Solid_clinically_localized_tx", "Solid_neoadjuvant", "Solid_topical",
  "Solid_radition_systemic_tx", "Solid_adjuvant_after_defintive_tx", 
  "Solid_Metastatic_tx_naieve", "Solid_Metastatic_2ndline_beyond", 
  "Heme_Treatment_naieve", "Heme_Relapsed_and_or_referactory", 
  "Heme_BMT", "Study_Type", "Randomized", 
  "Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Control_Arm", 
  "Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Interventional_Arm", 
  "Control_Group_1_placebo_2SOCalone_3_none", 
  "Blinding_Practice_1_pt_blind_0_open", "Sponser", 
  "Location_Of_Trial", "Single_Site_Or_Multi_Site"
)

categorical_summary <- lapply(categorical_columns, function(column) {
  if (!is.null(data[[column]]) && length(unique(data[[column]])) > 0) {
    df <- as.data.frame(table(data[[column]]))
    colnames(df) <- c("Category", "Count")
    df$Percentage <- round((df$Count / sum(df$Count)) * 100, 1)
    df$Characteristic <- column
    df$Value <- paste0(df$Category, ": ", df$Count, " (", df$Percentage, "%)")
    return(df[, c("Characteristic", "Value")])
  } else {
    return(data.frame(Characteristic = column, Value = "No data available"))
  }
})

categorical_summary_df <- do.call(rbind, categorical_summary)

# Combine summaries
table_1_df <- bind_rows(continuous_summary, categorical_summary_df)

# Export to Excel
write_xlsx(list("Table 1" = table_1_df), path = "Table_1_Characteristics.xlsx")

# Display the final table
print(table_1_df)
```

```{r}
#Univariate
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(broom)

# Load the dataset
data_cleaned <- read_excel("AK_Clean_Temp_3.xlsx", col_types = c("text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", "text",
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "numeric", "text", "text",
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text"))
outcome <- "discontinuation_rate_total"  # Replace with the correct outcome variable name
# Set reference levels for categorical variables
data_cleaned$Study_Type <- relevel(factor(data_cleaned$Study_Type), ref = "Rct")
data_cleaned$Control_Group_1_placebo_2SOCalone_3_none <- relevel(factor(data_cleaned$Control_Group_1_placebo_2SOCalone_3_none), ref = "1")
data_cleaned$Sponser <- relevel(factor(data_cleaned$Sponser), ref = "Industry")
data_cleaned$Location_Of_Trial <- relevel(factor(data_cleaned$Location_Of_Trial), ref = "International")
data_cleaned$Did_Trial_State_Need_For_Clearly_Documented_Reasons_For_Withdrawal <- relevel(factor(data_cleaned$Did_Trial_State_Need_For_Clearly_Documented_Reasons_For_Withdrawal), ref = "No")

# Scale Number_Enrolled_In_Trial
data_cleaned$Scaled_Number_Enrolled_In_Trial <- scale(data_cleaned$Number_Enrolled_In_Trial)

trial_design_vars <- c(
  "Unblinding_Or_Cross_Over",
  "Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Interventional_Arm",
  "Heme_Relapsed_and_or_referactory",
  "Solid_radition_systemic_tx",
  "Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Control_Arm",
  "Scaled_Number_Enrolled_In_Trial",
  "Solid_Metastatic_tx_naieve",
  "Did_Trial_State_Need_For_Clearly_Documented_Reasons_For_Withdrawal",
  "Sponser",
  "Heme_Treatment_naieve",
  "Heme_BMT",
  "Solid_clinically_localized_tx","Solid_neoadjuvant",
  "Randomized",
  "Control_Group_1_placebo_2SOCalone_3_none",
  "Study_Type",
  "Location_Of_Trial",
  "Solid_adjuvant_after_defintive_tx",
  "Blinding_Practice_1_pt_blind_0_open",
  "Solid_Metastatic_2ndline_beyond",
  "Single_Site_Or_Multi_Site"
)
# Define mitigation strategy variables
mitigation_strategy_vars <- c(
  "Non_Specific_Effort" , "No_Mitigation_Stratigies"
)

# Function to extract effect size and 95% CI
get_model_results <- function(model) {
  confint <- confint(model) # Extract confidence intervals
  effect_size <- coef(model) # Extract coefficients
  p_values <- summary(model)$coefficients[, 4] # Extract p-values
  data.frame(
    Term = names(effect_size),
    Effect_Size = effect_size,
    CI_Lower = confint[, 1],
    CI_Upper = confint[, 2],
    P_Value = p_values
  )
}

# Create results data frames for both models
trial_design_results <- data.frame(
  Predictor = character(),
  Effect_Size_CI = character(),
  P_Value = numeric(),
  Model_Type = character(),
  Reference_Level = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

trial_plus_mitigation_results <- data.frame(
  Predictor = character(),
  Effect_Size_CI = character(),
  P_Value = numeric(),
  Model_Type = character(),
  Reference_Level = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)



# Analyze trial design + mitigation strategy variables (Model 2)
for (predictor in c(trial_design_vars, mitigation_strategy_vars)) {
  if (predictor == "Number_Enrolled_In_Trial") {
    predictor <- "Scaled_Number_Enrolled_In_Trial"
  }
  
  if (predictor %in% names(data_cleaned)) {
    model <- lm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", predictor)), data = data_cleaned)
    model_results <- get_model_results(model)
    
    if (nrow(model_results) >= 2) {  # Ensure at least 2 rows for intercept and predictor
      predictor_row <- model_results[2, ]
      
      # Format effect size with CI
      effect_size_ci <- paste0(
        round(predictor_row$Effect_Size, 4),
        " (", round(predictor_row$CI_Lower, 4), ", ", round(predictor_row$CI_Upper, 4), ")"
      )
      
      trial_plus_mitigation_results <- rbind(trial_plus_mitigation_results, data.frame(
        Predictor = predictor,
        Effect_Size_CI = effect_size_ci,
        P_Value = round(predictor_row$P_Value, 4),
        Model_Type = ifelse(predictor %in% trial_design_vars, "Trial Design", "Mitigation Strategy"),
        Reference_Level = ifelse(is.factor(data_cleaned[[predictor]]), levels(data_cleaned[[predictor]])[1], NA)
      ))
    }
  }
}



# Sort results by p-value
trial_design_results <- trial_design_results %>% arrange(P_Value)
trial_plus_mitigation_results <- trial_plus_mitigation_results %>% arrange(P_Value)

# Extract predictors dynamically from the univariate results table
predictors <- trial_plus_mitigation_results$Predictor

# Print to confirm
print(predictors)

# Save results to Excel
write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Trial Design Only" = trial_design_results,
    "Trial + Mitigation" = trial_plus_mitigation_results
  ),
  "Univariate_Analysis_Two_Models_with_Reference_and_CI.xlsx"
)

# Print results
print(trial_plus_mitigation_results)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
#Linearity assumptions
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(lmtest)
library(dplyr)

# Define function to check assumptions
check_assumptions <- function(predictor, data, outcome) {
  # Fit linear model
  formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", predictor))
  model <- lm(formula, data = data)
  
  # Initialize assumption results
  assumption_results <- data.frame(
    Predictor = predictor,
    Linearity = NA,
    Normality_p = NA,
    Homoscedasticity_p = NA,
    Independence_p = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # 1. Linearity: Scatterplot or boxplot
  if (is.numeric(data[[predictor]])) {
    plot1 <- ggplot(data, aes_string(x = predictor, y = outcome)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
      labs(title = paste("Linearity: Outcome vs", predictor), x = predictor, y = outcome)
    print(plot1)
    assumption_results$Linearity <- "Checked (Scatterplot)"
  } else {
    plot1 <- ggplot(data, aes_string(x = predictor, y = outcome)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(title = paste("Boxplot: Outcome by", predictor), x = predictor, y = outcome)
    print(plot1)
    assumption_results$Linearity <- "Checked (Boxplot)"
  }
  
  # 2. Normality of Residuals
  residuals <- residuals(model)
  qqnorm(residuals)
  qqline(residuals, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  shapiro_test <- shapiro.test(residuals)
  cat("\nShapiro-Wilk Test for Normality of Residuals (p-value):", shapiro_test$p.value, "\n")
  assumption_results$Normality_p <- shapiro_test$p.value
  
  # 3. Homoscedasticity: Residuals vs Fitted Values
  fitted_values <- fitted(model)
  plot2 <- ggplot(data.frame(Fitted = fitted_values, Residuals = residuals), aes(x = Fitted, y = Residuals)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
    labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted Values", x = "Fitted Values", y = "Residuals")
  print(plot2)
  bp_test <- bptest(model)
  cat("\nBreusch-Pagan Test for Homoscedasticity (p-value):", bp_test$p.value, "\n")
  assumption_results$Homoscedasticity_p <- bp_test$p.value
  
  # 4. Independence: Durbin-Watson Test
  dw_test <- durbinWatsonTest(model)
  cat("\nDurbin-Watson Test for Independence (p-value):", dw_test$p.value, "\n")
  assumption_results$Independence_p <- dw_test$p.value
  
  return(assumption_results)
}

# Variables to check (from trial+mitigation results)
variables_to_check <- trial_plus_mitigation_results$Predictor

# Initialize summary table
assumption_summary <- data.frame(
  Predictor = character(),
  Linearity = character(),
  Normality_p = numeric(),
  Homoscedasticity_p = numeric(),
  Independence_p = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Check assumptions for each variable
for (predictor in variables_to_check) {
  cat("\n\n### Checking Assumptions for Predictor:", predictor, "###\n")
  if (predictor == "Scaled_Number_Enrolled_In_Trial") {
    predictor <- "Number_Enrolled_In_Trial"  # Adjust naming if scaled
  }
  if (predictor %in% names(data_cleaned)) {
    results <- check_assumptions(predictor, data_cleaned, outcome)
    assumption_summary <- rbind(assumption_summary, results)
  } else {
    cat("Variable", predictor, "not found in the dataset.\n")
  }
}

# Save summary table to Excel
write_xlsx(assumption_summary, "Regression_Assumptions_Summary.xlsx")

# Print summary table
print(assumption_summary)
```

```{r}

#Multivariate
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(mgcv)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

# Load the dataset
data_cleaned<- read_excel("AK_Clean_Temp_3.xlsx", col_types = c("text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", "text",
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "numeric", "text", "text",
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text"))

# Log-transform the outcome variable to handle skewness
data_cleaned$log_total_withdrawl_noreason_rate <- log(data_cleaned$total_withdrawl_noreason_rate + 1e-8) # Avoid log(0)
data_cleaned$Scaled_Number_Enrolled_In_Trial <- scale(data_cleaned$Number_Enrolled_In_Trial)
data_cleaned$Sponser <- factor(data_cleaned$Sponser)
data_cleaned$Study_Type <- factor(data_cleaned$Study_Type)
data_cleaned$Control_Group_1_placebo_2SOCalone_3_none <- factor(data_cleaned$Control_Group_1_placebo_2SOCalone_3_none)
data_cleaned$Location_Of_Trial <- factor(data_cleaned$Location_Of_Trial)
data_cleaned$Did_Trial_State_Need_For_Clearly_Documented_Reasons_For_Withdrawal <- factor(data_cleaned$Did_Trial_State_Need_For_Clearly_Documented_Reasons_For_Withdrawal)
data_cleaned$Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Control_Arm <- factor(
  ifelse(data_cleaned$Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Control_Arm %in% c("Mono", "None"), "Non-Combo", "Combo"),
  levels = c("Combo", "Non-Combo") # Set "Combo" as the reference level
)

# Switch reference levels
# Combine all non-RCT levels into "Non-RCT"
data_cleaned$Study_Type <- factor(
  ifelse(data_cleaned$Study_Type == "Rct", "Rct", "Non-RCT"), # Recategorize all non-RCTs
  levels = c("Non-RCT", "Rct") # Set the desired levels with "Non-RCT" as the reference
)

# Combine all non-Industry levels into "Non_industry"
data_cleaned$Sponser <- factor(
  ifelse(data_cleaned$Sponser == "Industry", "Industry", "Non_industry"), # Recategorize non-Industry sponsors
  levels = c("Non_industry", "Industry") # Set the desired levels with "Non_industry" as the reference
)


# Combine "Unclear" and "Yes" into "_Yes/Unk"
data_cleaned$Did_Trial_State_Need_For_Clearly_Documented_Reasons_For_Withdrawal <- factor(
  ifelse(data_cleaned$Did_Trial_State_Need_For_Clearly_Documented_Reasons_For_Withdrawal %in% c("Unclear", "Yes"), "_Yes/Unk", "No"),
  levels = c("_Yes/Unk", "No") # Set "_Yes/Unk" as the reference level
)

# Convert the variable to a factor
data_cleaned$Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Interventional_Arm <- factor(data_cleaned$Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Interventional_Arm)

# Set "Combo" as the reference level
data_cleaned$Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Interventional_Arm <- relevel(data_cleaned$Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Interventional_Arm, ref = "Combo")

# Verify the levels
levels(data_cleaned$Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Interventional_Arm)

# Define predictors and mitigation strategy variables
predictors <- c(
  "Solid_clinically_localized_tx", "Solid_Metastatic_2ndline_beyond", "Solid_neoadjuvant",
  "Heme_Treatment_naieve", "Sponser", "Solid_radition_systemic_tx", 
  "Heme_BMT", "Unblinding_Or_Cross_Over", "Solid_Metastatic_tx_naieve", 
  "Study_Type", "Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Interventional_Arm", "Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Control_Arm",
  "Location_Of_Trial", "Solid_adjuvant_after_defintive_tx", 
  "Did_Trial_State_Need_For_Clearly_Documented_Reasons_For_Withdrawal", 
  "Control_Group_1_placebo_2SOCalone_3_none", "Heme_Relapsed_and_or_referactory", 
  "Randomized", "Blinding_Practice_1_pt_blind_0_open", "Single_Site_Or_Multi_Site", 
  "Scaled_Number_Enrolled_In_Trial"
)
mitigation_strategy_vars <- c("Non_Specific_Effort", "No_Mitigation_Stratigies")

# Create GAM formulas
gam_formula_with_mitigation <- as.formula(paste(
  "log_total_withdrawl_noreason_rate ~", 
  paste(c(predictors, mitigation_strategy_vars), collapse = " + ")
))
gam_formula_without_mitigation <- as.formula(paste(
  "log_total_withdrawl_noreason_rate ~", 
  paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")
))

# Fit GAM models
gam_model_with_mitigation <- gam(gam_formula_with_mitigation, data = data_cleaned, family = gaussian(link = "identity"))
gam_model_without_mitigation <- gam(gam_formula_without_mitigation, data = data_cleaned, family = gaussian(link = "identity"))

# Function to create summary with variable names, effect sizes, and 95% CI
extract_summary_with_ci <- function(model_summary) {
  coef_table <- as.data.frame(model_summary$p.table)
  coef_table$Variable <- rownames(coef_table) # Add variable names
  coef_table$LowerCI <- coef_table$Estimate - 1.96 * coef_table$`Std. Error`
  coef_table$UpperCI <- coef_table$Estimate + 1.96 * coef_table$`Std. Error`
  coef_table$Effect_Size_CI <- paste0(
    round(coef_table$Estimate, 4), 
    " (", round(coef_table$LowerCI, 4), ", ", round(coef_table$UpperCI, 4), ")"
  )
  return(coef_table[, c("Variable", "Effect_Size_CI", "Pr(>|t|)")])
}

# Extract summaries
summary_with_mitigation <- extract_summary_with_ci(summary(gam_model_with_mitigation))
summary_without_mitigation <- extract_summary_with_ci(summary(gam_model_without_mitigation))

summary(gam_model_with_mitigation)

# Write summaries to Excel
write_xlsx(list(
  "With Mitigation" = summary_with_mitigation,
  "Without Mitigation" = summary_without_mitigation
), "GAM_Model_Summaries_With_CI.xlsx")

```

```{r}
#Simplieifed model

library(dplyr)
library(MASS)

# Check for missing values in the dataset
missing_summary <- colSums(is.na(data_cleaned))
print("Missing values in each column:")
print(missing_summary)

# Impute missing values for numeric variables using the median
data_cleaned <- data_cleaned %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), median(., na.rm = TRUE), .)))

# Impute missing values for categorical variables using the mode
data_cleaned <- data_cleaned %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.factor), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), levels(.)[which.max(table(.))], .)))

# Define outcome variable and predictors
outcome <- "log_total_withdrawl_noreason_rate"
all_predictors <- c(
  "Unblinding_Or_Cross_Over", "Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Interventional_Arm", "Solid_neoadjuvant",
  "Heme_Relapsed_and_or_referactory", "Solid_radition_systemic_tx",
  "Mono_Or_Combo_Therapy_In_Control_Arm", "Scaled_Number_Enrolled_In_Trial",
  "Solid_Metastatic_tx_naieve", "Did_Trial_State_Need_For_Clearly_Documented_Reasons_For_Withdrawal",
  "Sponser", "Heme_Treatment_naieve", "Heme_BMT", "Solid_clinically_localized_tx",
  "Randomized", "Control_Group_1_placebo_2SOCalone_3_none", "Study_Type",
  "Location_Of_Trial", "Solid_adjuvant_after_defintive_tx", "Blinding_Practice_1_pt_blind_0_open",
  "Single_Site_Or_Multi_Site", "Non_Specific_Effort", "No_Mitigation_Stratigies"
)

# Ensure predictors exist in the dataset
all_predictors <- all_predictors[all_predictors %in% names(data_cleaned)]

# Create the formula for the full model
full_formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(all_predictors, collapse = " + ")))

# Fit the initial linear model
initial_model <- lm(full_formula, data = data_cleaned)

# Perform stepwise selection
stepwise_model <- stepAIC(initial_model, direction = "both")

# View the summary of the final model
summary(stepwise_model)

library(writexl)

# Extract the summary of the final model
model_summary <- summary(stepwise_model)

# Create a data frame with variable names, coefficients, 95% CI, and p-values
results_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(model_summary$coefficients),
  Estimate = model_summary$coefficients[, "Estimate"],
  StdError = model_summary$coefficients[, "Std. Error"],
  LowerCI = model_summary$coefficients[, "Estimate"] - 1.96 * model_summary$coefficients[, "Std. Error"],
  UpperCI = model_summary$coefficients[, "Estimate"] + 1.96 * model_summary$coefficients[, "Std. Error"],
  PValue = model_summary$coefficients[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
)

# Add a formatted column for effect size with 95% CI
results_table$EffectSize_CI <- paste0(
  round(results_table$Estimate, 4), 
  " (", round(results_table$LowerCI, 4), ", ", round(results_table$UpperCI, 4), ")"
)

# Select relevant columns for export
results_table <- results_table[, c("Variable", "EffectSize_CI", "PValue")]

# Export to Excel
write_xlsx(results_table, "Stepwise_Model_Results.xlsx")
```

```{r}
library(readxl)

# Load the data
data <-  read_excel("AK_Clean_Temp_3.xlsx", col_types = c("text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", "text",
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "numeric", "text", "text",
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text"))

# Calculate overall withdrawal count
overall_withdrawal <- sum(
  data$total_discontinued_study_termination,
  data$total_withdrew_noreason,
  data$total_withdrew_because_ae,
  data$total_withdrew_because_pod,
  data$total_withdrew_because_complicationsmedical,
  data$total_withdrew_because_othertx,
  data$total_withdrew_because_exclusioncriteria,
  data$total_withdrew_because_noncompliance,
  data$total_withdrew_because_death,
  data$lost_fu,
  data$total_withdrew_because_other_specified_reason,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Summarize the data for specific reasons
summary_data <- data.frame(
  Reason = c(
    "Total Discontinued Study Termination",
    "Total Withdrew (No Reason)",
    "Withdrawal Due to AE",
    "Withdrawal Due to Progression of Disease",
    "Other Specified Reasons",
    "Exclusion Criteria (Ineligibility)",
    "Death"
  ),
  Total_Count = c(
    sum(data$total_discontinued_study_termination, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$total_withdrew_noreason, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$total_withdrew_because_ae, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$total_withdrew_because_pod, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$total_withdrew_because_complicationsmedical, na.rm = TRUE) + 
      sum(data$total_withdrew_because_othertx, na.rm = TRUE) + 
      sum(data$total_withdrew_because_other_specified_reason, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$total_withdrew_because_exclusioncriteria, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$total_withdrew_because_death, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

# Calculate percentages and standard errors
summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round((Total_Count / overall_withdrawal) * 100, 2),
    SE = sqrt((Percentage / 100) * (1 - Percentage / 100) / overall_withdrawal) * 100,
    Lower_SE = pmax(0, Percentage - SE),
    Upper_SE = pmin(100, Percentage + SE)
  )

# Create a bar plot with standard error bars
ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = reorder(Reason, -Percentage), y = Percentage, fill = Reason)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower_SE, ymax = Upper_SE), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Reason",
    y = "% of Trial Discontinuations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Calculate percentages for the selected reasons
percentage_data <- data.frame(
  Reason = c(
    "Noncompliance",
    "Withdrew (No Reason) Total",
    "Lost to Follow-up"
  ),
  Total_Count = c(
    sum(data$total_withdrew_because_noncompliance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$total_withdrew_noreason, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(data$lost_fu, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

# Number of patients enrolled in trials
total_enrolled <- sum(data$Number_Enrolled_In_Trial, na.rm = TRUE)

# Calculate percentages and standard errors
percentage_data <- percentage_data %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = (Total_Count / total_enrolled) * 100,
    SE = sqrt((Percentage / 100) * (1 - Percentage / 100) / total_enrolled) * 100,
    Lower_SE = pmax(0, Percentage - SE),
    Upper_SE = pmin(100, Percentage + SE)
  )

# Reorder the data by descending percentage
percentage_data <- percentage_data %>%
  arrange(desc(Percentage)) %>%
  mutate(Reason = factor(Reason, levels = Reason))

# Create the bar graph
ggplot(percentage_data, aes(x = Reason, y = Percentage, fill = Reason)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower_SE, ymax = Upper_SE), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Reason for withdrawal",
    y = "Percentage of Patients Enrolled in Trial (%)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 10),  # Set Y-axis max to 10%
    breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2),  # Set intervals to 2%
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# Define the specified columns for mitigation practices
specified_columns <- c(
  "Contact_Patients_Lost_To_FU", "Encouragement", "Home_Nursing", 
  "No_Mitigation_Stratigies", "Patient_Education", "Protocol_Amendments", 
  "Supportive_Care", "Telemedicine", "Non_Specific_Effort", 
  "Unblinding_Or_Cross_Over", "Dosing_Or_Schedule_Adjustments", 
  "Continued_Tx_After_Withdrawl_Or_Re_Challenge"
)

# Ensure the specified columns exist in the dataset
missing_columns <- setdiff(specified_columns, colnames(data_cleaned))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(paste("The following columns are missing from the dataset:", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")))
}

# Calculate count and percentage for each specified column
summary_table <- data_cleaned %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(specified_columns), ~ sum(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Reason", values_to = "Count")

# Calculate total count to use for percentage calculation
total_count <- sum(summary_table$Count, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add percentage and format output
summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round((Count / total_count) * 100, 1),
    Value = paste0(Count, " (", Percentage, "%)")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Reason, Value)  # Explicitly call select() from dplyr

# Display the final summary table
print(summary_table)
```

```{r}


# Mitigation practice graph
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)

# Define the specified columns for mitigation practices
specified_columns <- c(
  "Contact_Patients_Lost_To_FU", "Encouragement", "Home_Nursing", 
  "No_Mitigation_Stratigies", "Patient_Education", "Protocol_Amendments", 
  "Supportive_Care", "Telemedicine", "Non_Specific_Effort", 
  "Unblinding_Or_Cross_Over", "Dosing_Or_Schedule_Adjustments", 
  "Continued_Tx_After_Withdrawl_Or_Re_Challenge"
)

# Ensure the specified columns exist in the dataset
missing_columns <- setdiff(specified_columns, colnames(data_cleaned))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(paste("The following columns are missing from the dataset:", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")))
}

# Calculate count and percentage for each specified column
summary_table <- data_cleaned %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(specified_columns), ~ sum(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Reason", values_to = "Count")

# Calculate total count to use for percentage calculation
total_count <- sum(summary_table$Count, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add percentage and standard errors
summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round((Count / total_count) * 100, 1),
    SE = round(sqrt((Percentage / 100) * (1 - (Percentage / 100)) / total_count) * 100, 1),
    Lower_SE = pmax(0, Percentage - SE),
    Upper_SE = pmin(100, Percentage + SE)
  )

# Combine rows with percentages less than 3% into "Other"
summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    Reason = ifelse(Percentage < 3, "Other", Reason)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Reason) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percentage = round((Count / total_count) * 100, 1),
    SE = round(sqrt((Percentage / 100) * (1 - (Percentage / 100)) / total_count) * 100, 1),
    Lower_SE = pmax(0, Percentage - SE),
    Upper_SE = pmin(100, Percentage + SE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Percentage))

# Export the updated summary table to Excel
write_xlsx(summary_table, "Specified_Columns_Summary_Updated_with_SE.xlsx")

# Plot a bar chart with standard error bars
ggplot(summary_table, aes(x = reorder(Reason, -Percentage), y = Percentage, fill = Reason)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower_SE, ymax = Upper_SE), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Mitigation Practice",
    y = "% of clinical trials"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"  # Remove legend
  )
```

```{r}


# Data availability after withdrawal and need for clear reasons for withdrawal graph
# Load the data
data_cleaned <-  read_excel("AK_Clean_Temp_3.xlsx", col_types = c("text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", "text",
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "numeric", "text", "text",
     "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
     "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text", "text", "text", "text", 
     "text"))

# Define the columns to summarize
columns_to_summarize <- c(
  "Did_Trial_State_Need_For_Clearly_Documented_Reasons_For_Withdrawal", 
  "Data_Availability_After_Withdrawl"
)

# Ensure the columns exist in the dataset
missing_columns <- setdiff(columns_to_summarize, colnames(data_cleaned))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(paste("The following columns are missing from the dataset:", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")))
}

# Calculate counts, percentages, and standard errors for each column
# Calculate counts, percentages, and standard errors for each column
summary_table <- lapply(columns_to_summarize, function(column) {
  data_cleaned %>%
    count(!!sym(column)) %>%
    rename(Response = !!sym(column), Count = n) %>%
    mutate(
      Percentage = round((Count / sum(Count)) * 100, 1),
      SE = round(sqrt((Percentage / 100) * (1 - (Percentage / 100)) / sum(Count)) * 100, 1),
      Lower_SE = pmax(0, Percentage - SE),
      Upper_SE = pmin(100, Percentage + SE),
      Variable = column  # Add 'Variable' column inline
    )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()  # Combine results into a single data frame

# Export the summary to an Excel file
write_xlsx(list("Counts_and_Percentages" = summary_table), path = "Counts_and_Percentages_Summary_with_SE.xlsx")

# Add an additional variable for facet titles at the bottom
summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    Facet_Title = case_when(
      Variable == "Did_Trial_State_Need_For_Clearly_Documented_Reasons_For_Withdrawal" ~ "Did trial state need for clearly documented reasons?",
      Variable == "Data_Availability_After_Withdrawl" ~ "Data availability after withdrawal?"
    )
  )

# Plot a bar chart with error bars using standard errors
ggplot(summary_table, aes(x = Response, y = Percentage, fill = Response)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower_SE, ymax = Upper_SE), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Facet_Title, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,  # Remove default x-axis label
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    title = NULL  # Remove default title
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.placement = "bottom",  # Place facet titles at the bottom
    panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"),
    legend.position = "none"  # Remove legend
  )


```
